name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Sync bank transactions from SimpleFin into Wealthfolio automatically.
author: Bubbles840

permissions.purpose: Show existing accounts, and optionally create new Wealthfolio accounts, for mapping to SimpleFin accounts
Import bank transactions, reconcile pending transactions (create/update/delete), and link transfer pairs
Open a mapped account's page in Wealthfolio when its row is clicked
Read current account balances to size one-time starting-balance corrections
Store SimpleFin credentials and sync configuration securely
Fetch transaction data from SimpleFin Bridge
Register sidebar navigation item and route for SimpleFin Sync
